title: Cub Cadet Recalls Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Air in the brake system can cause brake failure, posing a crash hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 4,000.

title: Lumicentro Internacional with Home Depot Recalls Crystal Chandeliers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The halogen bulbs sold with the chandeliers can melt parts of the fixture, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 10,500.

title: ZORJAR Recalls Women's Scarves Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The women's scarves fail to meet the federal flammability standard for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 1,700.

title: Manhattan Toy Recalls Activity Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The colored plastic tubes on the product can become brittle and break into small pieces, posing a choking hazard to infants. Units: About 14,400 (in addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman 570 All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak, Fire Hazards
summary: Fuel can leak into the headlight pod, posing fuel leak and fire hazards. Units: About 25,600.

title: Corbeau USA Recalls Camlock Seat Harness Belts Due to Fall and Projectile Hazards
summary: One of the five harness belts can unlock during use and allow the user to fall out of or be thrown from the vehicle, posing a risk of serious injury or death. Units: About 2,000.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR 570 and RZR S 570 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The front brake can detach, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 1,160.

title: TJX Recalls Glass Beer Mugs Due to Burn and Laceration Hazards; Sold Exclusively at HomeGoods Stores
summary: The glass beer mug can break if heated or used with hot liquid, posing burn and laceration hazards. Units: About 500 (in addition, about 1,500 were sold in Canada).

title: TOMY Recalls Munching Max Chipmunk Toys Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Parts inside the toy can break creating a sharp point that can penetrate the surface of the toy, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 9,300 (In addition, 4,700 were sold in Canada).

title: YSN Imports Recalls Refillable Propane Cylinders Due to Fire, Explosion Hazards
summary: The refillable propane cylinders can leak propane gas, posing fire and explosion hazards. Units: About 24,000 (in addition, 1,100 were sold in Canada).

title: Core Health & Fitness Recalls Exercise Machines Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The height adjusting carriage assembly can loosen and fall on the consumer, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 3,600.

title: TriggerTech Recalls Crossbow And Rifle Triggers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Rollers on the triggers can crack causing the weapon to discharge without trigger activation, posing an injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 2,000 (in addition, about 2,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Superpedestrian Recalls Electric Bicycle Conversion Wheels Due to Fall and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The rear axle can fail, posing fall and crash hazards to riders. Units: About 230.

title: Nestlé Waters North America Recalls AccuPure Water Dispensers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The dispensers can overheat and smoke, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 12,300.

title: Really Good Stuff Recalls Magnetic Dry Erase Boards Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The thin magnetic metal surface can separate from the product's wooden board, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1.6 million.

title: Outxpro Mosquito Zapper LED Light Bulbs Recalled by R & D Products Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The LED light bulb's base can separate from the connector, posing an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 3,700.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR 170 Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fuel Leak, Fire Hazards
summary: The fuel tank neck can crack or the wiring harness can overheat or short circuit, posing fuel leak and fire hazards. Units: 16800.

title: Quality Foam Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,200.

title: iRover Recalls Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a risk of smoking, catching fire and/or exploding. Units: About 2,800.
